Electoral results of Vox, candidates by level, the faceted cartogram of its vote and its access to regional government, and the maps of its territorial penetration.

```{r SETUP}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(httr2)
library(countrycode)
library(mapSpain)
library(stargazer)
library(rvest)
library(here)

# tables are printed as text here; use type = "html" (or "latex") for the written document
table_type <- "text"

# objects made by 02_data_extraction.qmd
load(here("data", "processed", "02_data_extraction.RData"))

# objects made by 03_satellite_organisations.qmd
load(here("data", "processed", "03_satellite_organisations.RData"))

# objects made by 04_data_enrichment.qmd
load(here("data", "processed", "04_data_enrichment.RData"))
```

# Electoral results

```{r TABLE VOX RESULTS}
# one row per election: general elections keep Congress and Senate apart,
# regional elections held on the same day are counted together
vox_results <- vox_candidates |>
  filter(is_titular %in% c(TRUE, NA)) |>
  mutate(contest = if_else(level == "National", str_c(election, " ", chamber), election)) |>
  group_by(level, date, contest) |>
  summarise(lists            = n_distinct(chamber, province),
            candidates       = n(),
            seats_won        = sum(is_elected %in% TRUE),
            lists_with_seats = n_distinct(chamber[is_elected %in% TRUE], province[is_elected %in% TRUE]),
            expected_seats   = sum(top_expected),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(factor(level, levels = c("National", "Autonomical", "Municipal")), date) |>
  select(Level = level, Election = contest, Lists = lists, Candidates = candidates,
         `Expected seats` = expected_seats, `Seats won` = seats_won, `Lists with seats` = lists_with_seats)

stargazer(as.data.frame(vox_results), summary = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, type = table_type,
          title = "Vox electoral results by election",
          notes = "Titular candidates only. Expected seats: candidates placed within the expected seats of their list.")
```

```{r FACETED CARTOGRAM MAP}
library(mapSpain)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(cartogram)

# Vox's vote and its access to regional government in the four phases of the party, on
# a contiguous cartogram (r-graph-gallery.com/331-basic-cartogram). Each region is
# resized by its area times Vox's vote share there: the total size of Spain does not
# change, and a region grows where Vox did better than its own average and shrinks where
# it did worse. The size compares Vox with itself, not with the other parties
phases <- tribble(
  ~phase,       ~phase_start,       ~phase_end,
  "2014-2017",  ymd("2014-01-01"),  ymd("2017-12-31"),
  "2018-2019",  ymd("2018-01-01"),  ymd("2019-12-31"),
  "2020-2022",  ymd("2020-01-01"),  ymd("2022-12-31"),
  "2023-2026",  ymd("2023-01-01"),  ymd("2026-12-31")
)

# ---- 1. Vox's vote share by region in the general elections of each phase -------------
# Congress results by constituency (Ministry of the Interior, infoelectoral, data/raw/infoelectoral_results).
# There was no general election in 2020-2022: that phase keeps the result of November
# 2019, the one in force during it
general_by_phase <- tribble(
  ~file,                   ~phase,       ~election,
  here("data", "raw", "infoelectoral_results", "prov_02_201512_1.zip"),  "2014-2017",  "December 2015",
  here("data", "raw", "infoelectoral_results", "prov_02_201606_1.zip"),  "2014-2017",  "June 2016",
  here("data", "raw", "infoelectoral_results", "prov_02_201904_1.zip"),  "2018-2019",  "April 2019",
  here("data", "raw", "infoelectoral_results", "prov_02_201911_1.zip"),  "2018-2019",  "November 2019",
  here("data", "raw", "infoelectoral_results", "prov_02_201911_1.zip"),  "2020-2022",  "November 2019",
  here("data", "raw", "infoelectoral_results", "prov_02_202307_1.zip"),  "2023-2026",  "July 2023"
)

# the party names are in row 2 or 3 of each file and the column labels in row 4; the
# provinces start in row 5. Where Vox did not run, its votes are empty (0 votes)
general_results <- tibble(file = unique(general_by_phase$file)) |>
  mutate(results = map(file, \(f) {
    raw   <- read_excel(unzip(f, exdir = tempdir()), col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text")
    vox   <- which(unlist(raw[2, ]) == "VOX" | unlist(raw[3, ]) == "VOX")[1]
    valid <- which(unlist(raw[4, ]) == "Votos válidos")
    rows  <- which(str_detect(raw[[2]], "^[0-9]+$"))
    tibble(cpro        = str_pad(raw[[2]][rows], 2, pad = "0"),
           vox_votes   = replace_na(as.numeric(raw[[vox]][rows]), 0),
           valid_votes = as.numeric(raw[[valid]][rows]))
  })) |>
  unnest(results)

# 52 constituencies in every file (must return 0 rows)
general_results |> count(file) |> filter(n != 52)

# provinces added up to regions, and the elections of each phase averaged
vote_by_phase <- general_by_phase |>
  left_join(general_results, by = "file", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  left_join(esp_codelist |> distinct(cpro, codauto), by = "cpro") |>
  summarise(vote_share = 100 * sum(vox_votes) / sum(valid_votes), .by = c(phase, election, codauto)) |>
  summarise(vote_share = mean(vote_share), .by = c(phase, codauto))

# ---- 2. Vox in the regional government, or propping up a PP government --------------
# a Vox post counts in a phase if it started before the phase ended and ended after it
# started (posts still held have no end date)
vox_in_government <- vox_executive_positions |>
  mutate(start = dmy(start_date), end = coalesce(dmy(end_date), today())) |>
  left_join(tribble(~region,                 ~codauto,
                    "Andalucía",             "01",
                    "Aragón",                "02",
                    "Castilla y León",       "07",
                    "Comunidad Valenciana",  "10",
                    "Extremadura",           "11",
                    "Región de Murcia",      "14"), by = "region") |>
  cross_join(phases) |>
  filter(start <= phase_end, end >= phase_start) |>
  distinct(codauto, phase)

# PP governments that owed their investiture to the votes of Vox without Vox entering
# them, in office at some point of the phase
pp_needs_vox <- tribble(
  ~codauto, ~phase,       ~investiture,
  "01",     "2018-2019",  "Juan Manuel Moreno, January 2019 (PP-Cs)",
  "13",     "2018-2019",  "Isabel Díaz Ayuso, August 2019 (PP-Cs)",
  "14",     "2018-2019",  "Fernando López Miras, July 2019 (PP-Cs)",
  "01",     "2020-2022",  "Juan Manuel Moreno, in office until July 2022",
  "13",     "2020-2022",  "Isabel Díaz Ayuso, in office until 2021 and invested again with Vox votes in June 2021",
  "14",     "2020-2022",  "Fernando López Miras, in office until 2023",
  "04",     "2023-2026",  "Marga Prohens, July 2023"
)

# ---- 3. one contiguous cartogram per phase ----------------------------------------------
# equal-area projection (the cartogram works with areas); the Canary Islands are moved
# next to the peninsula before the calculation
regions <- esp_get_ccaa(epsg = "3035") |>
  select(codauto) |>
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)))

# weight = area x vote share relative to Vox's national share in the phase. A region
# where Vox did not run keeps 5% of its size (a weight of zero cannot be drawn)
vox_cartogram <- phases$phase |>
  map(\(p) regions |>
        left_join(filter(vote_by_phase, phase == p), by = "codauto") |>
        mutate(phase    = p,
               relative = vote_share / weighted.mean(vote_share, area),
               weight   = area * pmax(relative, 0.05)) |>
        cartogram_cont("weight", itermax = 15)) |>
  bind_rows() |>
  mutate(status = case_when(
           str_c(codauto, phase) %in% str_c(vox_in_government$codauto, vox_in_government$phase) ~ "Vox in the government",
           str_c(codauto, phase) %in% str_c(pp_needs_vox$codauto, pp_needs_vox$phase)           ~ "PP government that needed Vox's votes",
           TRUE                                                                                  ~ "Neither") |>
           factor(levels = c("Vox in the government", "PP government that needed Vox's votes", "Neither")))

# ---- 4. the map ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# national vote share in each phase, for the panel titles
phase_names <- general_by_phase |>
  left_join(general_results, by = "file", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  summarise(vote_share = 100 * sum(vox_votes) / sum(valid_votes), .by = c(phase, election)) |>
  summarise(label = str_c(first(phase), "\n", str_c(election, collapse = " and "), ": ",
                          str_c(format(round(vote_share, 1), nsmall = 1), "%", collapse = " and ")),
            .by = phase) |>
  deframe()

ggplot(vox_cartogram) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = status), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Vox in the government"                 = "#1b7a3d",
                               "PP government that needed Vox's votes" = "#9fd3ad",
                               "Neither"                               = "grey70"),
                    drop = FALSE, name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ phase, ncol = 2, labeller = as_labeller(phase_names)) +
  labs(title = "Vox's vote and its access to regional government",
       subtitle = "Regions resized by Vox's vote there: larger where Vox did better than its own average",
       caption = str_c("Size: area of the region times Vox's share of the valid vote in the general elections of the phase,\n",
                       "relative to its national share (a region where Vox did not run keeps 5% of its size).\n",
                       "Colour: Vox held a post in the regional government, or its votes were needed to invest a PP president,\n",
                       "at any point of the phase. Source: Ministry of the Interior (infoelectoral). Canary Islands moved next to the peninsula.")) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(text = element_text(colour = "#22211d"),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = NA),
        legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#f5f5f4", colour = NA),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, colour = "#4e4d47"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5, colour = "#4e4d47", margin = margin(b = 8)),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0, colour = "grey40"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 4)),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10))
```

```{r MAP COUNCILLERS PRE 2018}
library(mapSpain)
library(sf)

# Vox councillors elected in the 2015 municipal elections (Vox's only local seats before 2018)
councillors_2015 <- vox_candidates |>
  filter(level == "Municipal", year == 2015, is_elected %in% TRUE) |>
  count(province, chamber, name = "councillors") |>
  mutate(muni_key = chamber |>
           str_to_upper() |>
           stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
           str_split("/") |>
           map_chr(\(x) str_c(sort(str_squish(x)), collapse = "/")))

municipalities_map <- esp_get_munic(epsg = "3857") |>
  left_join(provinces, by = c("cpro" = "province_code")) |>
  mutate(muni_key = name |>
           str_to_upper() |>
           stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
           str_split("/") |>
           map_chr(\(x) str_c(sort(str_squish(x)), collapse = "/")))

councillors_map <- municipalities_map |>
  inner_join(councillors_2015, by = c("muni_key", "province"))

# councillors whose municipality was not found on the map (must return 0 rows)
councillors_2015 |> anti_join(st_drop_geometry(councillors_map), by = c("muni_key", "province"))

# one point per municipality, at its centroid
councillors_centroids <- st_centroid(councillors_map)

councillors_points <- councillors_centroids |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  bind_cols(as_tibble(st_coordinates(councillors_centroids)))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = esp_get_prov(epsg = "3857"), fill = "grey95", colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = esp_get_can_box(epsg = "3857"), colour = "grey60") +
  geom_point(data = councillors_points, aes(X, Y, size = councillors), colour = "#009E73") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = councillors_points, aes(X, Y, label = str_c(name, " (", councillors, ")")),
                           size = 3, min.segment.length = 0) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 5), breaks = 1:3, name = "Councillors") +
  labs(title = "Vox councillors before 2018",
       subtitle = "Municipal elections of May 2015") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r TABLE VOX CANDIDATES BY LEVELS}
# profile of the candidates at each level (one row per candidacy); the Total column counts
# every candidacy once, so a person elected at two levels is one of its elected people
candidates_by_level <- vox_candidates |>
  bind_rows(vox_candidates |> mutate(level = "Total")) |>
  mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c("National", "Autonomical", "Municipal", "Total"))) |>
  group_by(level) |>
  summarise(`Candidacies`                        = n(),
            `Different people`                   = n_distinct(person_id),
            `Different people elected`           = n_distinct(person_id[is_elected %in% TRUE]),
            `Elections`                          = n_distinct(election),
            `Women (%)`                          = round(100 * mean(sex[!is.na(sex)] == "Female"), 1),
            `Elected (%)`                        = round(100 * mean(is_elected %in% TRUE), 1),
            `Within expected seats (%)`          = round(100 * mean(top_expected), 1),
            `Seat in previous election (%)`      = round(100 * mean(had_seat_before), 1),
            # has_prev_party is TRUE or NA: the NA count as no party on record
            `Ran for another party before (%)`   = round(100 * mean(has_prev_party %in% TRUE), 1),
            `In the CEN before the election (%)` = round(100 * mean(in_cen_before), 2),
            `Organic position in Vox (%)`        = round(100 * mean(has_organic_position), 2),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(level = as.character(level)) |>
  pivot_longer(-level, names_to = "Variable") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = value)

stargazer(as.data.frame(candidates_by_level), summary = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, type = table_type,
          title = "Vox candidates by level of election",
          notes = "One row per candidacy. Sex of municipal candidates inferred from the forename (INE census).")

# the same variables for the candidates within the expected seats and the rest
candidates_by_expected <- vox_candidates |>
  mutate(group = if_else(top_expected, "Within expected seats", "Rest of the list")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(`Candidacies`                        = n(),
            `Women (%)`                          = round(100 * mean(sex[!is.na(sex)] == "Female"), 1),
            `Elected (%)`                        = round(100 * mean(is_elected %in% TRUE), 1),
            `Seat in previous election (%)`      = round(100 * mean(had_seat_before), 1),
            `Ran for another party before (%)`   = round(100 * mean(has_prev_party %in% TRUE), 1),
            `In the CEN before the election (%)` = round(100 * mean(in_cen_before), 2),
            `Mean list position`                 = round(mean(list_position, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(-group, names_to = "Variable") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = value)

stargazer(as.data.frame(candidates_by_expected), summary = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, type = table_type,
          title = "Candidates within and outside the expected seats")
```


```{r MAP VOX GOVERNMENT}
# regions where Vox has held regional government posts, by coalition period
government_by_region <- vox_executive_positions |>
  mutate(period = if_else(str_ends(start_date, "2026"), "2026 onwards", "2022-2024")) |>
  group_by(region, period) |>
  summarise(posts = n_distinct(position), .groups = "drop") |>   # Limia and Higuero held the same post
  mutate(codauto = case_match(region,
                              "Andalucía"            ~ "01",
                              "Aragón"               ~ "02",
                              "Castilla y León"      ~ "07",
                              "Comunidad Valenciana" ~ "10",
                              "Extremadura"          ~ "11",
                              "Región de Murcia"     ~ "14"))

government_map <- esp_get_ccaa(epsg = "3857") |>
  cross_join(tibble(period = c("2022-2024", "2026 onwards"))) |>
  left_join(government_by_region, by = c("codauto", "period"))

ggplot(government_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = posts), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = esp_get_can_box(epsg = "3857"), colour = "grey60") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#b7e4c7", high = "#1b7a3d", na.value = "grey90",
                      breaks = 1:4, name = "Vox posts in\nthe regional government") +
  facet_wrap(~ period) +
  labs(title = "Vox in regional governments") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```


```{r TABLE VOX IN REGIONAL GOVERNMENTS}
# every government post, and whether the person had been a Vox candidate in that election
executive_table <- vox_executive_positions |>
  left_join(vox_candidates |> distinct(name = person_id, election) |> mutate(candidate = "Yes"),
            by = c("name", "election")) |>
  mutate(candidate = replace_na(candidate, "No"),
         end_date  = replace_na(end_date, "in office")) |>
  select(Region = region, Name = name, Position = position, From = start_date, To = end_date,
         `Vox candidate in that election` = candidate)

stargazer(as.data.frame(executive_table), summary = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, type = table_type,
          title = "Vox members of regional governments")
```


```{r TABLE PREVIOUS PARTY OF VOX CANDIDATES}
# candidacies by the parties the person had run for before (a candidacy can count for several)
previous_party_table <- vox_candidates |>
  filter(has_prev_party) |>
  separate_longer_delim(prev_party, " | ") |>
  mutate(level = factor(level, levels = c("National", "Autonomical", "Municipal"))) |>
  count(prev_party, level) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(Total = National + Autonomical + Municipal) |>
  arrange(desc(Total)) |>
  rename(`Previous party` = prev_party)

stargazer(as.data.frame(previous_party_table), summary = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, type = table_type,
          title = "Vox candidacies by previous party",
          notes = "Parties the person had run for in an earlier year. A candidacy can count for several parties.")
```


```{r TABLE MULTI-LEVEL CAREERS}
# how many people ran at one, two or three levels, and how often they were elected
careers <- vox_candidates |>
  group_by(person_id) |>
  summarise(levels     = str_c(sort(unique(level)), collapse = " + "),
            n_levels   = n_distinct(level),
            elections  = n_distinct(election),
            ever_elected = any(is_elected %in% TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(`Levels` = levels) |>
  summarise(People                  = n(),
            `Mean elections`        = round(mean(elections), 2),
            `Ever elected (%)`      = round(100 * mean(ever_elected), 1),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(People))

stargazer(as.data.frame(careers), summary = FALSE, rownames = FALSE, type = table_type,
          title = "Vox candidates by the levels of election they ran in")
```


```{r TERRITORIAL PENETRATION IN GENERAL ELECTIONS}
library(mapSpain)
library(sf)

# ------------------------------------ constituencies where Vox ran a Congress list
vox_general <- vox_candidates |>
  filter(chamber == "Congress") |>
  distinct(election, province) |>
  left_join(provinces, by = "province") |>
  mutate(presented = "Yes")

# constituencies that could not be placed in a province (must return 0 rows)
vox_general |> filter(is.na(province_code))

general_elections <- vox_general |>
  distinct(election) |>
  mutate(election_label = str_replace(str_extract(election, "[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}"), "_", "-"))

# ------------------------------------------ one map per election, all provinces
vox_presence_map <- esp_get_prov(epsg = "3857") |>
  cross_join(general_elections) |>
  left_join(vox_general |> select(election, cpro = province_code, presented),
            by = c("election", "cpro")) |>
  mutate(presented = replace_na(presented, "No"))

vox_presence_general <- ggplot(vox_presence_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = presented), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_sf(data = esp_get_can_box(epsg = "3857"), fill = NA, colour = "grey60") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#009E73", "No" = "grey90"),
                    name = "Vox list") +
  facet_wrap(~ election_label) +
  labs(title = "Provinces where Vox ran in each general election") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

vox_presence_general

```


```{r TERRITORIAL PENETRATION IN AUTONOMICAL ELECTIONS}
library(mapSpain)
library(sf)

# regional constituencies that are not provinces: islands, districts, regional lists
constituency_to_province <- tribble(
  ~province_key,                ~province_code,
  "REGION DE MURCIA",           "30",
  "PRIMERA",                    "30",
  "SEGUNDA",                    "30",
  "TERCERA",                    "30",
  "CUARTA",                     "30",
  "QUINTA",                     "30",
  "CENTRO",                     "33",
  "OCCIDENTE",                  "33",
  "ORIENTE",                    "33",
  "MALLORCA",                   "07",
  "MENORCA",                    "07",
  "EIVISSA",                    "07",
  "FORMENTERA",                 "07",
  "GRAN CANARIA",               "35",
  "LANZAROTE",                  "35",
  "FUERTEVENTURA",              "35",
  "TENERIFE",                   "38",
  "LA PALMA",                   "38",
  "LA GOMERA",                  "38",
  "EL HIERRO",                  "38",
  "CIRCUNSCRIPCION AUTONOMICA", "35",
  "CIRCUNSCRIPCION AUTONOMICA", "38",
  "CIUDAD",                     "13",   # "Ciudad Real" cut in the source
  "ALAVA",                      "01"
) |>
  bind_rows(provinces |>
              mutate(province_key = province |> str_to_upper() |> stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII")) |>
              select(province_key, province_code))

# ------------------------------- provinces that voted in each regional election
regional_lists <- autonomical_candidates |>
  filter(year >= 2014) |>
  mutate(province_key = province |> str_to_upper() |> stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |> str_squish()) |>
  left_join(constituency_to_province, by = "province_key", relationship = "many-to-many")

# constituencies that could not be placed in a province (must return 0 rows)
regional_lists |> filter(is.na(province_code)) |> distinct(chamber, province)

regional_elections <- regional_lists |>
  distinct(election, cpro = province_code) |>
  left_join(esp_codelist |> distinct(cpro, ccaa = ccaa.shortname.es), by = "cpro") |>
  group_by(election) |>
  mutate(election_label = str_c(str_replace(str_extract(election, "[0-9]{4}_[0-9]{2}"), "_", "-"), "\n",
                                if_else(n_distinct(ccaa) == 1, first(ccaa), str_c(n_distinct(ccaa), " regions")))) |>
  ungroup()

vox_regional <- regional_lists |>
  filter(abbreviation == "VOX") |>
  distinct(election, cpro = province_code) |>
  mutate(presented = "Yes")

# ------------------------------------------ one map per election, all provinces
vox_presence_regional_map <- esp_get_prov(epsg = "3857") |>
  cross_join(regional_elections |> distinct(election, election_label)) |>
  left_join(regional_elections |> distinct(election, cpro) |> mutate(voted = TRUE), by = c("election", "cpro")) |>
  left_join(vox_regional, by = c("election", "cpro")) |>
  mutate(presented = case_when(!is.na(presented) ~ "Yes",
                               voted             ~ "No",
                               TRUE              ~ "No election"),
         presented = factor(presented, levels = c("Yes", "No", "No election"))) |>
  # keep only elections where Vox skipped at least one province that voted
  group_by(election) |>
  filter(any(presented == "No")) |>
  ungroup()

vox_presence_regional <- ggplot(vox_presence_regional_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = presented), colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_sf(data = esp_get_can_box(epsg = "3857"), fill = NA, colour = "grey60") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "#009E73", "No" = "grey65", "No election" = "white"),
                    name = "Vox list") +
  facet_wrap(~ election_label, ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Regional elections where Vox did not run everywhere") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8))

vox_presence_regional
```
